attributes.name: Ghostbane Shotgun +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 2d4+2. You may additionally bury this card to add another 2d4. If the bane has the Incorporeal trait, add another 1d8. If any die rolled on this check is a 1, count it as a 2. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on a 1, shuffle this card into your deck.

Shuffle this card into your deck to add 2d4 to a combat check by another character at your location. If the bane has the Incorporeal trait, add another 1d8. After the check, that character is dealt 2 Ranged Combat damage.
